nom: Clinique Moisture Surge Broad Spectrum SPF 28 Sheer Hydrator Moisturizer

avis.texte: I like this moisturizer for daytime wear. It has sunscreen but does not leave a white cast It really does give a glow up. It can be worn alone or under foundation. I would not use it overnight because I do not think sunscreen is good for nighttime skincare.

avis.titre: I just found this product and fell in love with it!
avis.texte: I have been a Clinique girl for decades but this product was new to me. I fell in love with it immediately. While not inexpensive, it's especially soothing in the summer when my skin needs that extra care. Just bought my second container!
My skin soaks this up! And makes my skin feel smooth and plus is the protection it offers.

Good hydration and sun protection in one product. The only drawback for me was that it left a somewhat oily finish after application. It may work better for drier skin types than for combination or oily skin

avis.titre: I love this product so much
avis.texte: This is the only moisturizer I've come across that actually keeps my skin hydrated all day and does not cause any irritation! In the summer and winter months my skin flares up horribly and with this moisturizer on I have no issues all day! I never let this product run out in my bathroom!
My new favorite daytime moisturizer with spf! I have very sensitive skin and this has no irritation!

I am a fan! I have mature skin and find this to be the best daytime moisturizer to use from Clinique. A little goes a long way and I apply it over my Wrinkle Repair Serum. My skin feels nourished and hydrated which helps reduce the look of fine lines. It's also helpful in making sure I use a sunscreen on my face. I'll definitely purchase again!

avis.titre: I would not buy this particular formula again
avis.texte: The SPF in this formula gives a gray cast to my skin and also makes it feel heavy on my skin (African American). I love the formula without the SPF.
I've tried to find cheaper alternatives several times but I always end up coming back to this product. Worth every penny!
This moisturizer has been able to keep my skin hydrated even with the cold weather! It's not too thick to where you feel like you're being suffocated but just enough to where you know it's quality.

I use sunscreen year round. In summer, when I reapply frequently, I prefer formulations with higher SPF, and less intense moisture. In winter the opposite is the case, I typically do not need to reapply, and want more moisture. The Moisture Surge with spf 27 is perfect for my needs, it's easily absorbed, and goes on nicely over my retinol treatment. No breakouts, nothing but supple and soft.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: Love this product for good skin care & sunscreen protection in the Florida sun :)
This product made my skin break out on kh chin with deep pimples making my skin look bumpy. I do not breakout, and I do not recommend.

I love the convenience of the 1 ounce moisture surge with SPF 28 because it goes with me wherever I go. I originally received a sample and fell in love with the moisturizing feel on my face and love SPF! Great product for all!
This is a must daily to hydrate my dry skin and add a SPF to protect my skin for the day ahead. I have been using this for years

I discovered this with SPF and decided to give it a try. I tend to forget to apply SPF on my face, so when I discovered this lil gem I was elated. I've even gotten my mom to start using it during the day.

As I have gotten older my oily skin is getting less. I used to have to rise my eyes because when the oil got into them, it would burn. Someone told I could use a cream moisturizer but use VERY LITTLE. I tried this AND I LOVE HOW IT FEELS ON MY SKIN. I tell anyone how it feels on your skin is what matters.

avis.titre: My go to day to day SPF
avis.texte: Love that it moisturizes and provides SPF protection without breaking me out.
I broke out in hives within and hour after using the first time
Love this product feel light and makes my skin feel super light and smooth

I have used Clinique products before and am satified with them. I am getting used to this product. My face feels moisturized but it doesn't have a sheen like I typically had with my other moisturizer.

avis.titre: Old Favorite + New Sun Coverage Bonus
avis.texte: I have loved all of the moisture surge products for years, so I was thrilled to see they added an SPF option! It feels a little thicker, like the moisture surge intense cream. Still super moisturizing, no weird smell, and the sun protection is great. I have a new favorite!

avis.titre: Absorbs quickly, not greasy, not white.
avis.texte: The first facial sunscreen moisturizer I've ever been able to sustain using. I have extremely sensitive dry skin and rosacea. I have no patience with using products that require work or time. I find it very convenient and rewarding to use this product every morning. I wish it weren't so expensive but I'll use it as long as I can.

avis.titre: This is the only moisturizer I use!
avis.texte: Moisture surge broad spectrum goes on so smooth and a little goes a long way. I love this product and use twice daily after washing my face.

avis.titre: I love the Clinque Surge Moisturizers!
avis.texte: I have been using Clinque Surge for several years exclusively. I decided to try one with SPF. Great product.
This is the 1st time to try this & I love it. I always like an SPF in moisturizer year round.
The cream is quite thick in consistency. I apply it in the morning after the vitamin C serum. I really like that it has SPF.

avis.titre: Moisturizer is too thick for daytime.
avis.texte: It made my face shiny and felt too heavy on my face. Plus, it's a little pricey for a daytime lotion.
I've worn Clinique all my adult life. I totally recommend this product with SPF, especially for us in South Texas!

I have used the moisture surge moisturizer for years! The SPF is a great addition! It blends and absorbs easily, a little goes a long way. It doesnt cause breakouts. Can easily apply makeup over top with no issue. Please keep this product around!

avis.titre: Not the results I was looking for!
avis.texte: I bought this during the Black Friday sale week and just started using it now in the summer months. I thought it would be perfect for days when I'm just going to be out in the sun occasionally (and don't need something with a higher SPF). Unfortunately, what I recently figured out is that this product is making my face break! I'm nearly 70! I haven't dealt with my face breaking out in decades. Sadly, I don't see how I can keep using this. Now I'm hesitant to buy another Clinique product with SPF. I see the DDMR now has an option with SPF 35 but I'd hate to buy another product I won't be able to use.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again.
avis.texte: This cream goes on smooth and easy. Leaves my skin with a nice dewy look.

Ive used the regular moisture surge product for years and I love it, so I thought I would love this as well. My face gets very red when I wear it. It looks like my skin can't breathe, and my skin gets hot. It does keep my face from getting burned as I go about my regular day.
This is a very great moisturizer. It leaves your skin hydrated and feeling refreshed. The downside is the price.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I really didn't care for the gel in this product, but I definitely love the cream with sunscreen. This also keeps my skin very hydrated. I definitely would continue using this product.
I love this thing. You can't go wrong with this moisturizer. Its perfect over clean skin and goes on smooth and creamy.

I really wanted to love an SPF product by Clinique so I ordered this cream, initially, I really liked it because the fragrance isn't overwhelming and the skin felt soft, but then it started piling and I was really not happy about that
Great moisturizer, smooth and easily absorbs in your skin and face; highly recommend!

I really wanted to like this - I've been a long-time user of the other moisture surge products. This one, no matter how little I use or how far I try to keep it from my eyes, somehow finds its way into my eyes by the end of the day and burns. I've tried to adjust my application methods, but fail ~80% of the time. Just doesn't seem worth it to keep torturing myself. Back to SPF in my foundation!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: Love Clinique products but this is one of my favorites. I live in the desert and my skin is extremely dry, even on my face. I love putting this on and then feeling that my face is still soft, hours later.

avis.titre: Like the texture and sun protection
avis.texte: Clinique's Moisture Surge™ Sheer Hydrator with SPF 28 feels lightweight and smooth on the skin, providing a nice balance of hydration and sun protection without greasiness. Great for daily wear, though those needing heavier moisture may want to layer it.
I was looking for a moisturizing product since I have oily/dry skin. I brow tech at Ulta advised this and baabby this is what the doctor ordered for ME❤
So far I like it. I've only gotten to wear it once and not in a 'sweaty hot' situation. I want to test it when it's hot outside and the sun is bright to make sure it works and holds up.

I love the moisture surge gel and was excited to try this! It goes on well and wears well under makeup with no heavy feeling or pilling. I am very fair skinned and didnt burn with this on while out in the sun for short amounts of time. However, after a couple of days of consistent use, my skin started to break out like crazy! This product is definitely not the one for me.
This product always peels on my face, whether I use it on its own or with other products.

avis.titre: Lightweight, deeply hydrating, and perfect for daily use
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizer for a while now and it's become a staple in my skincare routine. It feels incredibly light on the skin but provides long-lasting hydration. I have combination skin, and it keeps the dry areas soft without making the oily areas greasy. It absorbs quickly, layers well under sunscreen and makeup, and gives my skin a smooth, refreshed look. I love that it's oil-free and doesn't clog my pores. Definitely recommend it if you're looking for a reliable everyday moisturizer.

avis.titre: This made my skin dry and peel around my nose
avis.texte: This was the opposite of a moisturizer for me. Maybe it would be good for super oily skin but it made my skin very angry. I haven't been blowing my nose so there is no explanation besides the new product.

I've been using Clinique products for most of my adult life. The yellow moisturizer has always been too heavy for me but I like the light moisture surge 100H. Since I play a lot of golf, I was looking for a product with spf. I tried this one with the SPF 28, even though it is pricey, and it made my skin breakout - I'm 74!!

avis.titre: Leaves a film behind - use sparingly
avis.texte: The cream is ok but leaves a thin film behind that made my (normal) skin feel tight and dry. If you use a smaller amount you can correct the problem, but then what's the point of the cream?
I've been using moisture surge for a few years now and I've never been disappointed. It works incredible and my skin feels amazing — plus this one had SPF!!
I've been using this moisturizer for 4 years, leaving my complexion with a healthy glow

The clinique moisture surge without spf is my favorite day cream so i thought why not try it with spf? I used this one time and it pilled not five minutes later. Now i use all Clinique so it was the even better vitamin c from Clinique then this cream. Why on earth did it pill? I swear its my skin! What do i do?

I have extremely sensitive skin and this is the best moisturizer/sunscreen I've found! I started using the moisture surge line a year ago and fell in love with the products. I had been putting off trying this one because spf sometimes breaks me out. That, however, has not been a problem with this product! So glad I can wear spf now and not be afraid of what will happen to my skin after. Hoping this product and the moisture surge line is around for years to come!
This product does what is does to. My face is hydrated and has a glow. The plus is the spf
This product is amazing. My skin is glowing, and it is light.

avis.titre: Not moisturizing, For the body instead?
avis.texte: I tried this because I was exvited to slowly integrate spf into my skincare routine only to find that this product wasnt effective. - it is the only product ive every purchased where it seperated, created and left residue and was extremely drying - I tried to switch up when I applied it in my routine, during the day and how much and it stayed ineffective - For people with dry skin: dont buy it only makes it worse - extremely expensive product too, I didnt want to waste it so I used it on my arms legs and body and it worked so much better
Doesn't cause acne and also great moisturizer. Very dewy finish I love it.

I've been dealing with acne and acne scars since I've been very stressed lately. None of the creams I bought really helped until I used this! This leaves my skin so hydrated and I'm barely getting any acne and the scaring is almost gone! And the fact that this has SPF is just a cherry on top.

I'm a huge fan of the moisture surge hydrator and figured this would be the perfect addition of spf to my skincare routine. I was wrong. It feels like the moisturizer just sitz on the skin surface and dries. When it dries, my skin gets tight. It doesnt blend with Clinique liquid foundation and ends up being a pill-y mess. My skin broke out in acne and worsened my rosacea after one day of using this product. It was the only product i swapped in my skincare routine. Clinique missed the mark on this one.
At age 72, I am still searching for a good face cream!! This one works wonderfully!! It lasts longer so my skin looks.better than ever!!

I was super excited to try this but after two days it turnt my face red, broke me out, and dried my skin. Its four days later and my skin is still itchy and red. Anytime i take off my makeup my face stings and burns. Not worth it.

avis.titre: Love the moisture it adds to my skin!!
avis.texte: It really does moisturize my skin without leaving an oily layer that makes my foundation look unnatural.
I use this after I wash my face in the morning. My face feels soft all day. I also put it on after I wash my makeup off at night. Most people guess my age at 50. Or am 68.
Excited that what I thought I used was on sale, I ordered and realized that they sell a cream and a gel. Thought I ordered the gel but I did not. Wish I would've known this before purchasing.

I received this product from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I used this product over the summer and found it to be effective yet a thick sunscreen forward moisturizer. If you are looking for a strong sunscreen this would be a good alternative but for me it was a little too thick for daily usage.

avis.titre: I was replacing my Clinique moisturizer
avis.texte: This was not the right one. Its thicker but doesn't leave my face moisturized.

Ive been using clinique products for a long time and when they came up with this SPF moisturizer, i was super excited. The first night i tried it my whole face was burning, specially my eyes. It was alsmost like i touched chilies and then rubbed by eyes. I washed my eyes with cold water three times and went to sleep cause I literally couldnt bear it. Next morning when i woke up, my eyes were not burning anymore but they were swollen and it took the whole day for it to go down. Because of that, im even scared to try the eye cream from them. Ive always used their products with any hesitations, this one now made me cautious and im very skeptical of buying new products from them, specially skin care.

avis.titre: Great item.  Use in the morning.
avis.texte: I use this product every morning after the 3 step cleansing process. It is an important part of my morning routine.

avis.titre: Favorite product for my facial skin!
avis.texte: The Clinique moisturizer is amazing. I recommend to everyone. After using, I noticed a changed in my facial skin. My skin looks better, feels better, and seems to even reduce redness in my cheeks. I absolutely love this product! 10/10 for sure
lotion is ok but makes mmy face feel greasy. I prefer without the SPF
I wasn't so sure about this product at first but the more I just it the more I enjoy it, absorbs well into the skin and feels light. The added SPF is a plus!

I have used Clinique products for my entire life and have never had any problem, though my skin can be sensitive to other brands. I love the regular moisture surge hydrator, so I was excited to try the one with SPF. I have used other Clinique moisturizers with SPF so I assumed this one would be fine. However, it caused a dry, itchy allergic rash on my face, especially around my eyes. Sending it back, and disappointed!

I bought this by mistake. I usually use the regular moisture surge. This product made my skin extremely dry and made my face peel. It was gross. Definitely going back to the moisture surge without the spf.
Perfect for my dry skin. Added spf is great. Love this product.
I hate layering SPF, the fewer steps the better. This moisturizer is my favorite. The Sun protection is incredible and the moisturizer is unbeatable.
Will be using and buying this moisturizer from now on! It left my face feeling smooth and refreshed

As someone in my late 30s, I'm always on the lookout for products that can keep my skin hydrated and protected. The texture is super lightweight and sheer, which I love. It doesn't feel greasy at all, and my skin absorbs it almost instantly. It's perfect for layering under makeup or wearing solo for a natural glow. Hydration is key for me, especially with my skin starting to show signs of aging. This hydrator keeps my skin feeling plump and moisturized all day without any tightness. What really sets this product apart is the built-in SPF 28. While it's not the highest SPF out there, it's a nice bonus for daily wear when I'm not out in the sun for long periods. It makes my morning routine so much easier—moisturizer and sun protection in one step!
Got this free from influenster and like it but it doesn't really absorb into my skin

I fell in love at first try. My skin is very dry and has been as far back as I can remember. I've tried a multitude of products but they usually are too oily, leaves residue, etc. This was perfect! Leaving my skin moisturized all day with no residue.

avis.titre: Wonderful moisturizer, but a little heavy
avis.texte: I tested this moisturizer recently and was surprised by how much I did like it. It felt, to me, pretty heavy in application and similar to applying a face cream or sunscreen, which I didn't love at the beginning. It also has a bit of a sunscreen smell to it, in my opinion. However, after 5-10 min of drying, my skin felt great! Definitely supple and moisturized - so the initial application was really the only downside for me. After using it for a few days, the thickness didn't bother me quite as much. I will say that I still prefer a lighter weight moisturizer, but this certainly did what it claimed to do and I would recommend it based on my experience!
After using this a couple of times I've come to decide I prefer Cerva sunscreen lotion better. This one left my face feeling a little greasy and like it didn't rub into my skin well enough
Feels very moisturizing and lightweight. I have oily, acne prone skin but this works great with the other skincare products that tend to dry out my skin and it doesn't irritate or break out my skin.
Protects my skin from the sun and after a week I saw a change in my skin and it made my skin so moisturized

Only product by Clinique I've had bad reaction to. The chemical odor is overwhelming. Burned my skin and eyes. Lost money since part of set. I'm being honest and giving my experience. Probably will not bother you. I just had high hopes. I like their moisture surge products in general. I love the one without sunscreen.
Love the hydration this product has. My skin is extremely dry and I have noticed a difference after using this.

I've been on the hunt for the perfect daily moisturizer with sun protection, and I'm so thrilled to have discovered Clinique's Moisture Surge™ Broad Spectrum Sunscreen SPF 28 Sheer Hydrator! The texture is luxuriously thick and creamy, which honestly had me a bit worried at first. But let me tell you, a little bit of this product goes a long way! Once I applied just a small dollop, it absorbed into my skin like a dream—no greasy residue! Instead, my face felt incredibly hydrated and smooth, forming a perfect canvas for makeup application. With this moisturizer, my foundation glides on seamlessly, and I find that my makeup lasts longer too. But what truly stands out is the fresh, healthy glow I get from wearing it alone! On days when I want a more natural look, I simply skip the makeup entirely, and my skin shines radiantly. Plus, the SPF 28 gives me that added peace of mind while I enjoy my time outdoors. Overall, Clinique's Moisture Surge™ is a total game-changer. Whether you're prepping for a night out or enjoying a sunny day, this product truly elevates your skincare routine. If you're seeking a moisturizer that hydrates as much as it protects—all while leaving your skin looking absolutely radiant—look no further!
Love how it makes my skin feel and look! Perfect moisturizer that leaves your skin glowing, hydrated and supple. Absolutely recommended!

I'm absolutely loving the Clinique Moisture Surge SPF 28! This moisturizer provides a perfect balance of hydration and sun protection without feeling heavy or greasy. The sheer, lightweight formula absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling soft and hydrated all day long. It's also great under makeup, giving a smooth base without any pilling. Plus, the added SPF 28 is a bonus for everyday protection. Highly recommend this for anyone looking for a daily moisturizer that does it all!

avis.titre: Protecting and hydrating, but comes with a smell
avis.texte: I've been using the Moisture Surge™ Broad Spectrum SPF 28 Sheer Hydrator for a few weeks now, and overall, I'm quite pleased with it. The product sits beautifully under makeup and layers well over other skincare products. It provides a lovely, hydrating feel without any greasiness, which is perfect for my combination skin. However, I did notice that it has a very strong sunscreen scent, which is the only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5. If you're sensitive to scents, this might be something to consider. Despite this, the hydration and sun protection it offers make it a great addition to my daily routine.

avis.titre: i would buy this product again
avis.texte: i have tried a few different SPF moisturizers and they usually leave me looking white or leave me with some white streaks . i had got a sample of this product & when i tried it i gotta say i absolutely loved it ! this one doesn't do that, so i gotta say 10/10 a little pricey but i think it's worth it .
This moisturizer made my skin so smooth and soft and didn't make me too oily!

I've been trying this product for the last few weeks and it's great! While it isn't my all time favorite SPF moisturizer, it paired well with my skin type and didnt cause any irritation. I will forever be a Clinique fan.
This product is such an amazing cook. Great moisturizer with SPF. I really do recommend using an actual SPF before hand though.

avis.titre: Great product just not my everyday go to.
avis.texte: After using this product for a couple of weeks, it has helped rehydrate my skin however with that being said, I have also noticed my t zones become oily. I love clinique and I do like this product it is just not going to be my primary mosturizer.

avis.titre: Youthful glow for such an effective multitasker
avis.texte: I have been using Clinique products (Dramatically different & moisture surge 100H) and have never felt disappointed. I'm so excited to try this product as it combines moisturizer with sunscreen, so I can get 2 steps in my morning skincare routine done in 1 application. Its lightweight feature makes it easier to absorb into my skin. Neither greasy feel nor residue on my face: leaving smooth and soft finish. Overall, I'm satisfied with this hydration boost and sun protection combination.
I love the moisture surge line. I really enjoy that they have added an option with spf. I love how it looks on my skin, with or without makeup
Lightweight, easy to apply, feels light on my face and absorbs quickly. Love it.

I have tried Clinique's regular Moisture Surge moisturizer and can attest that this is essentially the same thing but with SPF! It does not leave a greasy feeling so this would be good for those with oily or combo skin. The smell is faint so it didn't irritate me as I am sensitive to smells. I removed a star only because I would love more SPF for a daytime moisturizer—28 SPF doesn't feel nearly protective enough but it's definitely better than nothing!
Absolutely love how smooth this applies. It doesn't feel heavy and feels like you are glowy with no effort needed.

This product is a great addition to any dry / combination skincare routine. Clinique's formula is lightweight and blends effortlessly into the skin, providing a natural-looking radiance without being too shimmery. The inclusion of SPF 28 is a perfect bonus, making it a good choice for daytime wear. I will say it can be a bit too shiny for my oily skin. It also definitely smells like a sunscreen, but the SPF is relatively low. However, it doesn't feel heavy or sticky once it's absorbed, and gives a really nice finish. It hydrates, protects, and illuminates the skin in one step. Highly recommended for anyone seeking a dewy look with added skin benefits.
i love this moisturizer! i like that it makes my dry skin feel very moisturized without making it feel greasy. it wears beautifully underneath makeup & the fact that it has spf is a plus!
Great, light moisturizer that doesn't leave a white cast or break my out, but I wish it had more sunscreen!

This moisturizer is incredibly gentle with my sensitive skin. It does smell like sunscreen, but that is expected. Otherwise, there is no strong smell. The packaging is sturdy and pretty. The finish is matte.
I love how this moisturizer made my face feel. I used it every day and every night. It was a super easy part of my daily routine and it made a huge difference. And it also smells amazing.

avis.titre: Leaves a glow from with in
avis.texte: I have combination to normal skin type while this moisturizer feels great on the skin and doesn't leave a white cast it does makes my skin produce more oil throughout my t-zone. It also has a slight sunscreen scent that lingers throughout the day after application. I can't wait to use this in the colder months I feel this would be perfect then.

avis.titre: Ok For A Sunscreen But Expensive
avis.texte: After using this product for a bit I can say that I like it. I've used clinique products for almost a decade and I love them because they don't make me break out. I think this formula is great but for the price with spf and having to reapply for actual sun protection throughout the day I would opt for the regular moisturizer without the additives and then a stronger more affordable sunscreen to reapply throughout the day. It was a great product but I think i'll stick to the original for now just because of the prices.
I love this! I enjoy the SPF factor, and the moisturizer also works perfectly on its own. Great stuff!
This is exactly what I would expect from a Clinique moisturizer. Soft, feels clean, easy to apply. I love it! And I especially love that it is SPF 28!
This moisturizer is very lightweight which makes it great for underneath makeup or to wear alone on a hot day. It's not extremely hydrating so I do use additional moisturizers with it on my dry skin.
